from fractions import Fraction as F

# P: a>2 and b>2 ; Q: a+b>4
# "Q is necessary for P"  <=> P implies Q
# "Q is sufficient for P" <=> Q implies P
vals = [F(n, 4) for n in range(-40, 41)]  # grid from -10 to 10, step 1/4, includes boundaries

P = lambda a, b: a > 2 and b > 2
Q = lambda a, b: a + b > 4

p_implies_q_counter = None  # P true, Q false
q_implies_p_counter = None  # Q true, P false
for a in vals:
    for b in vals:
        if P(a, b) and not Q(a, b) and p_implies_q_counter is None:
            p_implies_q_counter = (a, b)
        if Q(a, b) and not P(a, b) and q_implies_p_counter is None:
            q_implies_p_counter = (a, b)

print("Counterexample to P => Q (grid search):", p_implies_q_counter)

a, b = F(5), F(0)
